clear_repeated_gap_rule: At least two of the four prespecified backgrounds have negative success-rate differences versus same-run Clean in both C models, AND the equal-background mean paired state-cluster bootstrap 95% interval is wholly below zero for each model.
report_even_when_rule_not_met: All per-background absolute success counts, paired flip cells, descriptive negative effects, uncertainty and floor/ceiling limits remain reported. Failure to meet this finite-development criterion is not proof of universal robustness.
cluster: 20 physical states; preserve all appearances and both C models within a sampled state
